newsitem.title: CHINA: Dalian Wanda wins China league with unbeaten record.
newsitem.headline: Dalian Wanda wins China league with unbeaten record.

text.p: Dalian Wanda extended its winning streak in China's professional soccer league on Sunday to end the season at the top of the league, unbeaten in 34 games, the Xinhua news agency said.
The team from northeastern Dalian team began their unbeaten run in the 14th match of the previous season, Xinhua said.

It was the second time the Dalian team had won the league title. In 1994, the Dalian team surprised their opponents by taking the inaugural China professional league but last year it finished only third behind Shanghai Shenhua and Beijing Guo'an.
On Sunday, the Dalian team played against Sichuan Quanxin in Chengdu and Captain Xu Hong levelled the score 2-2 for Dalian just 30 seconds before the final whistle.
The draw was enough to keep the team at the top of the table, with 12 wins and 10 draws this season.

Defending champions Shanghai Shenhua, which played to seven consecutive draws in the season to drop out of title contention, conceded their third loss this season, losing 0-1 to hosts Beijing Guo'an on Sunday.
They remained in second place ahead of the Chinese Army team that was beaten 0-1 by Guangdong Hongyuan.
Tianjin Samsung played an exciting match against Guangzhou Apollo on home turf to win 2-1.
Shenzhen and Guangzhou Songri dropped to the second division after playing to goalless draws against Yanbian Hyundai and Jinan Taishan respectively.
